Commentary.Commentary: So that's all from this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Join us for the fourth ODI on 22nd January 2017 at 0850 IST. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Man of the Match, Steven Smith says that they bowled really well to restrict the opposition to 263 and then they did well with the bat to chase it down. Admits that Handscomb was lucky and that helps for sure as he has been batting really well and has carried his form from the Test series. Adds that he loves batting at the W.A.C.A and this pitch is special for him. (On his hairband) He replies that it belongs to Adam Zampa and that proved to be lucky for him so he doesn't plan on giving it back to him (smiles). Ends by saying that they will hope to wrap up the series in Sydney.

Mohammad Hafeez feels that they should have scored 300-plus but could not reach there. Adds that they realized quite early that the pitch deserves a 300-plus total. Also says that no balls are a part of the game and that happens with everyone. Finishes off by saying that the next two venues are going to suit their bowlers and they would look to bounce back in the series.

The Australian skipper, Steven Smith once again batted with authority and took the charge of the chase. He notched up his 8th hundred and in the process also completed 3000 ODI runs. As mentioned earlier, Pakistan started superbly with the ball but then failed to maintain the same intensity. Mohammad Amir was the best bowler on show but apart from him, the rest failed to create enough pressure.

Steven Smith joined forces with debutant Peter Handscomb and started the revival. Handscomb was very lucky early in his innings when he was caught on zero but the bowler had overstepped and then the substitute fielder Mohammad Nawaz dropped a straightforward catch at point when he was on 10. The debutant utilized the chances he got and along with his skipper added a big century partnership to throw Pakistan out of the match.

A comprehensive win for Australia and they go 2-1 up in the 5-match ODI series. Chasing 264, David Warner took the hosts off to a flier but then Pakistan bounced back to remove both the openers in quick time. The visiting team bowled superbly to apply pressure early on in the innings but slowly lost the plot.

FOUR! AUSTRALIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS! Junaid Khan angles in a full length ball on middle, Head presents the full face of the bat and caresses it down the ground past mid on for the winning runs. Handshakes all around and the players exchange pleasantries.
Length ball outside off, cutting back into the left-hander, Head defends it from the crease to the off side.
Shortish and outside off, Head cuts it off his back foot to point.
An overpitched ball outside off, driven off the front foot to extra cover.
Bowls it on a length and wide outside off, Head allows it through to the keeper.
Angles across a good length ball outside off, Smith strokes it off his back foot through covers and picks a single.
Junaid Khan is back on.
Fullish and angling in, Smith gets forward to defend and it comes off the inside edge. Rolls behind square leg and they collect a run. 4 more needed.
Short and on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Tickles it through mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
Plays it with soft hands to mid on and scampers across for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Slower short ball on off, Smith gets on top of the bounce and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary. Australia inch closer to 2-1!
Fullish and outside off, Smith lunges and defends it back off the inner half of the bat.
Full and angling back into the batsman from outside off, Head gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, defended from the crease.
Head has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Head stands back and glances it off his hips to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Head blocks it off his back foot.
Outside off, a play and a miss by Head.
Head has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Movement back into the batsman from a length outside off, Smith plays all over it and it sneaks through the gap between bat and body. The keeper fumbles too and they steal a bye.
Width on offer outside off, Head guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Shortish and outside off, Smith goes on his toes and taps it down on the off side for one.
8th ODI hundred for Steven Smith!

FOUR! Here it is! Top knock from a top class batsman. Hasan goes short with his length outside off, Smith latches onto it and pulls it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary. Another superlative century from the bat of Steven Smith and the crowd is giving him a good warm round of applause. Well played, Smudge!
FOUR! Fullish and on middle, Head picks it off his pads and whips it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. Too straight from the bowler there!
Length ball landing outside off, shaping in with some extra bounce, Head decides to defend it from the crease.
Bouncer around leg, Head ducks underneath it.
Good length ball on middle, Smith moves across the stumps and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Darts a full ball on leg, Smith gets across the stumps and keeps it out off his pads to the leg side.
On a good length and outside off, Head punches it through cover-point for a single.
Fullish and outside off, Head drives it through cover-point for a single.
On a length and around middle, Head is squared up in defense this time and gets a leading edge safely to the off side.
FOUR! A signature square drive from the bat of Head. He just takes his front leg to the pitch of the delivery and unfurls a beautiful shot to get off the mark.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Beauty! Full in length and on middle, nipping away a shade, Head tries to defend it from the crease but gets beaten.
Travis Head arrives.

OUT! Finally Pakistan get the breakthrough but it seems too late! Hasan digs in a short ball on off, Handscomb gets across the stumps to play the pull shot but gets it away off the gloves. The ball balloons in the air, Rizwan rushes across to his left and completes the catch with a full length dive. End of a 183-run stand. Not celebrating too much, Pakistan. Understandably so. 36 runs needed off 65 balls.
Snorter! A well-directed bouncer, Smith ducks underneath it at the very last moment.
Good length ball on off, Peter stays back and runs it down to third man for a run.
Helps it off his pads to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Handscomb opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Runs are flowing thick and fast! Short of a length ball around off, angling away, Smith shuffles across the stumps and pulls it with supreme timing and placement through mid-wicket. Another boundary for Australia. Smith moves into the 90s!
Mohammad Amir is back on.
FOUR! Superbly played this time! Too full in length and outside off, Peter reaches out for it and squeezes it fine down to third man for a boundary. 13 runs off the over!

FOUR! Another inside edge, another boundary. Is he doing it intentionally? Naah. On a length and outside off, Handscomb once again pushes at it with firm hands and inside edges it past the stumps and the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
Another inside edge and this time it goes on one bounce to the keeper. Would have dragged it onto the stumps on another day!
EDGY FOUR! Length delivery closer to the off stump line, Handscomb tries to run it down but it's too close to his body and he ends up chopping it down past the stumps to fine leg for a boundary.
A touch short and outside off, Smith punches it through the line and it goes on one bounce to point. The fielder takes the pace of the ball and they take a single.
Full in length and outside off, Smith shoulders arms.
Hasan Ali comes back into the attack.
An overpitched ball on off, Smith nudges it through wide mid on and gathers three runs. 10 runs off the over!
Good length ball on off, Peter helps it to mid-wicket and steals another run.
On a length and around off, Smith walks across the stumps and taps it down to mid-wicket for one.
Loose, too loose from the Aussie skipper. Full and angling away from the batsman, Smith tries to play a wristly drive but fails to connect.
FOUR! Nearly went all the way! Short in length around off, Smith this time top edges his pull shot over the keeper's head for a boundary at fine leg.
Pitches it full and around off, Handscomb opens the face of the bat and drives it through point for a single.
On the pads, eased through backward square leg for a brace. 9 runs off the over!
Uses his feet again and quietly nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single. 150-run stand comes up!
Jumps out of the crease and flicks it over the square leg umpire for another couple of runs in this over.
Flatter arm ball on off, Peter initially shapes up for the sweep shot but then presents a dead straight bat in defense.
Advances down the track to heave it over mid-wicket but it catches the inside half of the bat and runs to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Short and wide outside off, cut past the diving point fielder for a couple of runs.
A touch short and outside off, Handscomb stays back and steers it through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Lucky boundary for Peter! Junaid bangs in a short ball, Handscomb top edges his attempted pull shot over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Full and angling in, Smith closes the face of the bat and works it  through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Surgical precision! A fractionally overpitched delivery around off, Smith gets forward and threads the gap between mid off and short extra cover for a gorgeous boundary. Soothing to the eyes!
Full in length and outside off, Smith reaches out for it and drives it towards point. Handscomb rushes back as his skipper sends him back.
Good length ball outside off, moving away, Handscomb runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Junaid Khan is back into the attack. 87 needed off 96 balls.

Tossed up ball around off, Smith drives it through the line and Wasim moves across to his left to stop the ball. He has a shy at the striker's end and Smith has to duck to avoid getting hit. Imad is quick to apologize.
Floated full ball on middle, Smith nudges it towards short fine leg and Handscomb comes running down the track in search of a run. He is sent back immediately.
Short and wide outside off, Smith goes back and cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Full and on leg, quicker through the air, Smith goes down and sweeps it sweetly through backward square leg for a boundary.
Loopy full ball on off, Smith gets on the front foot and pushes it to short cover.
Flighted full ball on off, Peter dabs it to short third man and his skipper calls him through for a quick single.
Drinks break. 94 needed off 102 balls. Australia are cruising and Pakistan seems to be playing the waiting game here. They need a breakthrough from somewhere to stay in the game.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Turns it off his pads to square leg for one.
FOUR! Great shot! Loopy full ball on middle, Smith takes a long stride forward, goes down on one knee and muscles it over square leg for a boundary.
Walks down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked to square leg.
3000 ODI runs for Steven Smith!
Reaches another milestone! Short and outside off, Smith cuts it through point and collects three runs. Australia are doing it easily at the moment.
Extra bounce on this occasion, Smith closes the face of the bat and keeps it out off the inside edge to square leg.
Tickles it off his pads to the leg side, finds square leg.
Maiden ODI fifty for Peter Handscomb!

Fifty for the debutant! He started his Test career also with a fifty against South Africa. Charges down the track to a full ball and nudges it through mid-wicket for one. Peter has had his fair share of luck, was caught on naught off a no ball and then was dropped by Nawaz (sub) when he was on 10! Has made good use of it.
Flatter and fuller on middle, Handscomb plays it closer to his pads and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. Moves to 49!
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
FOUR! Well placed! Tossed up ball on middle, Peter goes down on one knee and nails his sweep shot. Finds the gap wide of square leg and it speeds away to the fence. 10 runs off the over!
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball down the leg side, Handscomb advances down the track and whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.

Follows the batsman down the leg side, bowls it a bit short, Handscomb steers it past short third man and collects three runs. Junaid pulls it back near the fence and it's a clean stop confirms the third umpire.
Flighted full ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler who failed to stop it cleanly but no run taken.
Shoaib Malik comes into the attack. Pakistan in desperate need of a breakthrough here. 119 needed off 120 balls.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
100-run stand between Smith and Handscomb!
Loopy and around off, Smith softly flicks it to square leg where the fielder dives and makes a half stop. Two runs taken.
Walks down the track and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Smith has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

Wide! Fires a full ball down the leg side, Smith tries paddle sweeping it but misses. Cry of anguish from the Aussie skipper. This is the third time if I'm not wrong he has failed to connect with this shot.
Arm ball around off, Smith stays back and punches it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on middle, Peter drives it down the ground to long on for a single.
Short again and this time Peter hooks it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder makes the save in the deep but cannot prevent the batsmen from taking three runs. 125 needed off 126 balls!
Nicely played in the air. Handscomb has to reach out for it as he fetches a short ball from around off and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. That one stayed a touch low.
Fullish again, this time Smith works it to the right side of the mid on fielder and picks up a quick single.
Full and angling in, Smith walks across the stumps and forces it down to mid on where the fielder makes a half stop with a tumble.
Short and wide outside off, Handscomb cuts it aerially but safely past backward point for a single.
Short and sliding down, Peter tries to pull but misses. Half a shout but nothing from the umpire.
Floated full ball on off, Peter jumps out of the crease drives it through mid off for a run.
Silly mid on comes in place.
Flatter on off, Smith forces it down to long on and picks up a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
17th ODI fifty for Steven Smith!
Fifty for the Australian skipper! Yet another responsible knock from him. Full in length and around off, Smith quietly pushes it down through mid off and rotates the strike.
Loopy full ball on middle, Handscomb walks down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Pitches it full and around off, Smith drives it straight back and the bowler jumps to parry it over his head to mid off.
Full and outside off, hit firmly through covers for one.
Seam movement there, on a fuller length and outside off, Handscomb tries to drive but misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Smith cracks it to point where the fielder misfields and they take a single.
Short and outside outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, Smith tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It ricochets to the cover region.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.

FOUR! Good calculated risk taken by Peter Handscomb. He shimmies down to the pitch of the delivery and flicks it in the air over mid-wicket. Doesn't try to hit it hard, just places his drop kick superbly and finds the fence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Shout for an lbw! Fires in an arm ball on middle, skidding in, Handscomb skips down the track for a big heave but misses and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal from the bowler the batsman is way down the track and the umpire shakes his head.
Wide! Arm ball around leg, skidding down, Peter leaves it alone. Good take by Rizwan.
Walks down and punches it back to the bowler. He misfields and parries it to mid on but no run taken.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long off for one.
Full and sliding down, Peter walks down the track and flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and flicks it wide of mid on for one.
Flatter and shorter on middle, punched to long on for a run.

FOUR! Quicker through the air, a touch short and around off, Smith picks it early, goes back and caresses it through extra cover. Finds the gap with precision and fetches a boundary. Beautiful batting, didn't try to over hit it.
Loopy and around off, Smith gets across the stumps and defends it to the leg side.
Dances down to the pitch of the fuller length ball and forces it to long on for one.
Hafeez pulls out again.
Full floated ball on middle, Smith moves back and punches it past his partner to long on for one.
Another short delivery and once again Smith cuts it. But this time it has gone straight to the fielder in the deep and hence only a run.
Wasim drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Smith goes back and cuts it firmly to deep point. Good stop in the deep and they have to satisfy with only two.
Loopy and around off, Smith gets forward and defends it to the leg side.
Presses forward and forces a full ball back. The bowler misfields in his followthrough and they take a single.
Advances down the track to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flighted full ball on middle, pushed down through mid on for a single.
Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
Goes back and punches it to long on for one.
Flatter and on the pads, played off the pads to square leg.
Hafeez pulls out at the last moment. Probably lost his run-up. Apologizes.
Fullish and around off, driven back to the bowler. Tidy stuff by Hafeez!
Floated and on middle, spinning in, Smith tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Smith tries to paddle sweep but misses. Called a wide!
Uppish but safe! Tossed up ball on middle, Peter gets forward and pushes it back aerially. Hafeez stretches to his right but it goes wide of him to long on for one.
Comes down the track and tries to flick but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.

Short again around off, this time Smith times his pull shot well and finds the gap. The fielder in the deep makes a diving stop and parries it towards the fielder coming in from fine leg. Two runs saved.
Fullish and on the pads, it's flicked to mid-wicket where Wasim dives to stop the ball. Still cannot prevent the single. 100 up for Australia!
Shortish and around off, Smith swivels with the pull shot but fails to middle it. It goes off the inner half of the bat and rolls through backward square leg for a single.
A touch short and around off, shaping back in a bit, Peter goes back and taps it down to covers for a quick single.
Lands it full again and outside off, Smith once again shuffles across the stumps and plays it down with soft hands. It rolls in front of square leg and they pick up a single.
Lands it full and outside off, holding its line, Smith gets across and shoulders arms.
Gets on the back foot and strokes it down to long on for one.
50-run stand between Smith and Handscomb.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball on off, Peter gets down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tickles it off his pads to the leg side, finds the gap and takes a single. This is smart batting.

SIX! Excellent shot by Smith! A loopy full ball around off, Smith shimmies down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over mid off. The fielder is inside the circle but it would not have mattered even if he would have been in the deep as the ball sails all the way over the rope for a maximum. Good clean hit!
Walks down the track to take it on the full and eases it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, driven to covers where the fielder dived to make a good stop.

Not out! Smith fetches a full ball from around off and flicks it wide of mid on. They complete the first run, slight fumble and they attempt for the second run as well. The throw comes to the bowler who breaks the stumps as Handscomb dives in. The third umpire is referred but the replays show that Peter was safely in.
Run out appeal is referred upstairs...
Good length delivery outside off, Smith covers the line and shoulders arms.
On a length and angling back into the batsman, Smith goes back to cover the line and defends it down safely.
FOUR! Quality shot from a quality batsman. Full in length outside off, Smith presses forward and with his long reach drives it crisply through extra cover for a boundary.
On a length and around middle and leg, Handscomb fails to get it away and it goes off his pads to the leg side. They steal a leg bye.
Quicker full on off, Smith tries to flick but gets a leading edge which goes safely towards mid off. Maiden by Hafeez! Good tight bowling.
Loopy full ball on off, Smith presents a straight back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Gets back and works it off his pads. Once again finds the square leg fielder. Pressure building!
Advances down the track and inside edges his attempted flick shot to square leg. Three dot balls now.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Smith hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Hafeez is back into the attack.
Length delivery around off, Handscomb tries to punch it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Smith steers it through point and Malik does well to move across to his right from third man and stop the ball. Three runs added to the total.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

What happened there? Full in length and outside off, Smith tries to play a cover drive off his front foot but it doesn't rise much and goes off the bottom edge to the keeper on one bounce. Smith is surprised.
A touch short and around off, Peter remains back and runs it down to third man for a single. It seems that Handscomb favours that region.
Full and angling away from the batsman, Smith gets forward, opens the face of the bat and pushes it through backward point for a single.
A touch short and on off, Smith punches it off his back foot to long off and retains strike. 13 runs off the over!
Wide! Fires a full ball down the leg side, Smith tries to play the paddle sweep but misses. Rizwan does well to get his body behind to stop the ball from racing away.
Bowls it flatter through the air, around middle, Handscomb forces it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and around middle, an arm ball, Smith goes back and punches it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Back to back boundaries from the bat of the Australian skipper! Flighted and full on middle, Smith shimmies down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Quick hands! Short in length and outside off, Smith goes deep inside the crease and cracks it through backward point for a boundary.
Loopy full ball on off, Handscomb walks down the track and drives it through mid off for a single.
Imad Wasim is into the attack now. A short leg in place.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith walks across the stumps to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Too full in length and on middle, Smith covers the line and digs it out back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and outside off, a good looking drive by Peter through backward point for one.
Width on offer this time, Handscomb plays the square cut but finds the point fielder.
Lands it on a length and closer to the off stump line, Handscomb tries to cut but it's too close to him and he ends up chopping it down in front of gully.
Smith opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Hasan Ali comes into the attack now.
Drinks break.
Shortish and around off, punched off the back foot to mid off.

DROPPED! That's a sitter gone down. Short of a length delivery wide outside off, Handscomb goes deep inside the crease and cuts it aerially through the line. It goes in and out of the backward point fielder's hands. Nawaz is the man who is on the field for Amir. A big miss, this. Steven Smith is not happy and gives a stare to his partner. Hang on, the replays later on shows that Junaid once again had overstepped. It wasn't noticed by the onfield umpire and hence no Free Hit given.
Spears in a fuller length ball on middle, Peter covers the line and closes the face of the bat in defense.
Edged but safe! Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Handscomb has a tame push inside the line and edges it behind. It goes on one bounce to the second slip fielder.
Beautiful timing. A good length ball around off, Handscomb goes back and punches it sweetly to the left of the mid off fielder. He chases it down in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Handscomb pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Mohammad Amir is going off the field. It seems he is done with his first spell.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it watchfully to end the over.
Back of a length ball outside off, Smith walks across the stumps and defends it down safely on the off side.
Full and outside off, Smith moves across the stumps and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Too straight in line on this occasion, Peter moves back deep inside the crease and nudges it to fine leg for one.
On a length around off, Peter plays it with soft hands and guides it past point for a couple of runs.
Shortish and around off, Handscomb camps back and tries to cut but fails to connect.
Another delivery in the corridor outside off, Smith this time leaves it alone.

Huge shout for a catch! Junaid angles across a full length ball outside off, Smith is sucked into a full-blooded cover drive but fails to make any connection. However, the Pakistan players get very excited as soon as Rizwan collects the ball. They have the option of reviewing it but have decided not to. Well, the way they appealed, they should have reviewed it.
Full and outside off, Peter tries to drive it through covers but ends up slicing it off the outer half of the bat. It flies wide of backward point for a single.
On a length and around off, Handscomb gets across the stumps and defends it on the leg side.
Drops it on a fuller length around off, Peter gets behind the line and defends it to the off side.
Full and around off, Smith gets across the stumps and eases it wide of mid on for a single.
On a length and outside off, zipping away off the pitch, Handscomb makes a watchful leave.
Beaten all ends up!  Fullish and angling away from the right-hander, Handscomb is lured into the drive but he is beaten by the away movement.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Handscomb watches the line closely and lets it through to the keeper.
Full in length and around off, swinging back in, Peter stays back footed and defends it to the off side.
Sliding down the leg side, it's nudged to fine leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Smith shows no intention of chasing it.
Speedy delivery, on back of a length outside off and leaving the batsman, Peter shoulders arms. End of an eventful over.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length ball on off, Handscomb punches it off his back foot to covers.

Free Hit - Four running runs! Short of a length ball around off, Peter hangs back and top edges his pull shot over mid-wicket. The ball falls just short of the fence and stops. They do well to gather all four runs.
Free Hit coming up...

IT'S A NO BALL! Khan hurls across a full ball outside off, Peter goes chasing at a wild delivery and edges it behind. The first slip fielder catches it cleanly and Pakistan are celebrating. Hang on, the umpire wants to check for the no ball. Oh dear, Junaid has overstepped and the debutant gets a life. Steven Smith has a word with him. Probably trying to calm him down.
Handscomb is caught at slips. The umpire is checking for the front foot no ball.
On a length and around middle, Smith gets across and works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish and angling away from the batsman, Smith gets across the stumps and defends it solidly.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. End of a successful over.

Angles across a full length ball outside off, good pace, 143 kph, Handscomb holds his pose inside the crease, covers the line and shoulders arms. Amir has a few words to share with the new batsman. Just trying to unsettle the debutant.
Debutant Peter Handscomb walks in next.

OUT! Khawaja departs! Amir lets out a fuller length ball wide outside off, a hint of inward swing there, Khawaja goes chasing at it in an attempt to play the cover drive but gets an inside edge behind to the keeper. Once again Rizwan takes a regulation catch and Australia have lost both their openers now.
In the channel outside off, Usman has nothing to do with it.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Khawaja tries to flick but misses.

Play and a miss! Ripper by Amir. Lands it on a length around off and gets it to straighten off the seam, Khawaja is squared up in defense as the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Was there an edge? The Pakistani fielders get excited but nothing from the umpire. Hafeez also decides not to take the referral. There was some sound to be honest but the Snicko doesn't detect anything.
Fullish and outside off, a good looking cover drive by Khawaja but he finds the fielder inside the ring.
Skipper Steven Smith is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Junaid strikes and Warner is out of here! He serves a length ball outside off and it holds its line after landing, Warner camps back to force it through the line but gets a faint nick behind to the keeper. Rizwan makes no mistake and Pakistan finally get a breakthrough. End of an itchy stay for Warner. Junaid is all smiles. This is a big breakthrough.
On a length and angling into the batsman, Warner gets behind the line and pushes it to mid on. Wants the single but his partner is ball watching.
Pitches it full and around off, angling in, Warner leans forward and pushes it to covers.
Junaid digs in a short ball around off, Warner this time decides to let it go to the keeper. Well left!
Top edge but safe! Drops it on a length and outside off, Warner tries to pull it across the line but gets a top edge. It clears mid off and they take two runs.
Fine leg comes up.

FOUR! A mishit but still a boundary! A fractionally short ball on off, Warner tries to pull it through mid-wicket but gets it away off the inside edge of the bat. It races through square leg as Wasim gives the chase. However, the ball wins the race.
Outswinger this time, around off, Warner pushes at it and outside edges it past backward point for a single. Amir is keeping Warner on the edge of his seat.
Beaten all ends up! Amir lets out a well cooked inswinger, Warner stands back to punch it through covers but it moves back in to beat the inside edge.
Fullish and sliding down the leg side, Usman eases it to long leg and picks up a single.
Once again Amir angles in a full ball on middle, Warner gets squared up and defends it with soft hands to covers. It's in the gap and Khawaja immediately calls him through for a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Warner leans forward and across to play it towards mid on. He is looking a bit tentative with his footwork against Amir.
Full in length on middle, defended on the leg side.
FOUR! Excellent shot! A fractionally overpitched ball on off, Khawaja gets behind the line with a straight bat and caresses it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.

Nearly a run out! Fullish and on off, Khawaja bunts it down to mid on and Warner comes out of the crease in search of a run. He is sent back and Warner makes it safely as Shoaib Malik fails to score a direct hit at the bowler's end.

Shout for an lbw! Junaid gets a length ball to nip back into the left-hander, Usman fails to work it across the line on the leg side and is hit high on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire. Again too high.
Full in length and outside off, Khawaja plays a cracking drive off his front foot but finds Babar Azam at cover-point.
Straighter in line on this occasion, Warner turns it through square leg and picks up a single.
Length ball shaping back into the batsman, Warner gets on top of the bounce, covers the line and defends it back solidly.
Back of a length delivery in the zone outside off, shaping away, Khawaja leaves it. Top class over, just one off it!
Length delivery in the channel outside off, Usman shoulders arms.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Unplayable! Amir is amidst a beautiful spell. Lets out yet another outswinger, closer to the off stump line, Warner pushes at it tamely and is beaten. Warner needs to be careful here!
Beaten! Beauty of a delivery by Amir. A lovely outswinger around off, fuller in length, Warner tries to drive without any footwork and gets beaten.
A touch short in length again, shaping back in, Khawaja tries to pull it from the crease but misses and is hit on the thigh pad. An expensive start from Junaid, 11 runs off the over!

A touch short in length and outside off, Warner latches onto it and pulls it across the line. The mid-wicket fielder inside the ring dives but fails to stop the ball. Good running between the wickets and they take three runs.
Slower delivery this time, full and angling in from outside off, Warner mistimes his shot back towards the bowler off the inner half of the bat.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full in length and outside off, Warner gets forward and drives it on the up. It's from the middle of the bat and races through extra cover for a gorgeous boundary.
FOUR! Tremendous use of the bottom hand! Warner picks a length ball from around off and powers it over mid-wicket for a powerful boundary.

Appeal for an lbw! Good length ball landing outside off and nipping back in sharply, Warner gets back to flick it on the leg side but misses and is hit high on the pads. They appeal but the umpire is not interested. Too high!
Junaid Khan is introduced into the attack.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Swings his bat to a length ball around off and gets it away off the inside edge. It rolls behind square leg and they pinch a single.
Shortish on off, punched to coves. Dot ball again.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Straighter in line, Warner goes deep inside the crease and tucks it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs. Good intent by David!
FOUR! Fast hands of Warner on display! Amir is a bit on the shorter side around off, Warner goes on the back foot and guides it with supreme timing through covers for a boundary.
Quicker again and around off, defended off the back foot.
Floated full ball on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Hafeez goes quicker and flatter this time, around off and skidding in, Usman goes deep inside the crease and punches it out to point.
FOUR! Fine footwork by Khawaja, he walks down to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Lovely shot.
Appeal for a catch! Full flighted ball on middle, Khawaja tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to Sharjeel at short leg. They appeal for a catch but nothing from the umpire.
Shorter and on off, Khawaja goes back and punches it to covers.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Warner plays it on the leg side and finds the same fielder. Fine start by Amir!
Brings a full length ball back into the left-hander, Warner moves back and closes the face of the bat in defense. Keeps it out to the fielder stationed in front of square leg.
Fullish and around off, Warner turns it on the leg side and Imad Wasim at mid-wicket makes a diving stop.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Warner jumps inside the crease and nudges it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Full and angling into the batsman, this time Warner gets on the front foot in defense.
Beauty to start the spell! Full swinging delivery outside off, Warner plays all over it, probably tries to whip it across the line but it moves away to beat the outside edge.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up ball on middle, forced down to long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Warner tries to run it down to third man but ends up chopping it down in front of first slip.
Flighted and full around off, Warner punches it to covers, Khawaja wants the single but is sent back.
Loopy full ball on middle, Warner gets on the front foot and defends it back.
FOUR! Once again Hafeez is on the shorter side outside off, Warner rocks back and cuts it off the outer half of the bat. It runs wide of backward point and beats the chase put in by Amir.
Starts with a shortish ball outside off, Warner cuts it from the crease to point.
Australians are back in the middle for the chase. Warner and Khawaja will start with the bat for the hosts. The visiting skipper Hafeez will start the proceedings with the ball.
